The '''222 Blaster Cannon''' was an anti-vehicle [[blaster artillery]] emplacement used by the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] to defend important installations. Built by [[Jakan Arms]], the 222 drew energy from a dedicated power generator, allowing it to fire an unlimited number of shots. The cannon normally required a crew of four to operate but could make due with half that number.<ref name="GOR" />

During the occupation of [[Goroth Prime/Legends|Goroth Prime]], a number of Imperial facilities were defended by 222 anti-vehicle emplacements.<ref name="GOR" />
